results.title: Young Female Playwright
results.overview: When 26-year-old Millie lands a career-making debut as playwright at Canada’s National Theatre, celebration quickly turns to scrutiny after a press release describes her play as a “deeply personal story”. Millie is sure that the dark, family-drama is a work of fiction; but her family is concerned, especially her Uncle Mark, a school teacher and recovered alcoholic. Through bright lights, and dark comedy, Young Female Playwright asks who gets to tell what story, and what it costs for a woman to be believed.

results.title: Amy Winehouse: The Tragic Downfall
results.overview: A documentary that delves into the life, career, and struggles of iconic British singer and songwriter Amy Winehouse. Through the archival footage, interviews with those who knew her and expert analysis, the film explores Amy's quick rise to fame, her battles with addiction and mental health issues, and the pressure of celebrity culture. It offers a poignant reflection on the music industry's impact on artists and devastating consequences of unchecked fame.

results.title: Queens of Combat: Rome's Female Gladiators
results.original_title: Queens of Combat: Rome's Female Gladiators
results.overview: What if women were hidden among the ranks of Ancient Rome’s fearsome gladiators? A group of experts searches for evidence to prove women once fought in the arena just like men. Combining history, archaeology, and forensic investigation, journey across Europe in a quest for answers. If a female gladiator's existence can be proven definitively, what can we learn about their lives?

results.title: Long Time Listener
results.overview: A true crime podcaster becomes the target of a dangerous 'long-time listener'.

results.title: My Share of Sky: Ek Mutthi Badal
results.original_title: My Share of Sky: एक मुट्ठी बादल
results.overview: A family drama exploring relationships, expectations, and changes across generations.

results.title: Little, Big, and Far
results.overview: Karl, a 70-year-old Austrian astronomer, is at a crossroads in life and work. After a conference in Greece, he decides not to return home and heads for a small island in hopes of finding a sky dark enough to reconnect with the stars.

results.title: Carnation
results.overview: A mother tells her daughter the fairy tale of a little girl named Karanfil Kız to help her fall asleep. According to the tale, Karanfil Kız goes to the cinema with her father, but she falls asleep in the movie theater. When she wakes up, she learns that her father is missing and begins to search for him.

results.title: Hermit
results.overview: A hermit’s decaying refuge on the edge of civilisation is shattered by his estranged son’s arrival.

results.title: Repu Udayam 10 Gantalaku
results.overview: A deadly countdown begins when strangers receive an ultimatum: escape before 10 a.m. tomorrow or face catastrophic consequences. With hours ticking away, survival depends on outrunning an escalating threat.

results.title: Kadhal Kadhai Sollava
results.overview: This story tells about "Micheal And Shreya" who participate in the Program , which Actor Vijaysethupathi Conducts through FM "Kadhal Kadhai Sollava"

results.title: Sometimes Sadness, Sometimes Rebellion
results.original_title: A veces me entra tristeza, otras veces rebelión
results.overview: Eva is just passing through Madrid. She spends her days there alone: she doesn't know anyone and isn’t particularly interested in getting to know new people. The city is therefore an unfamiliar place where she wanders aimlessly, her curiosity somewhat dampened. But one afternoon, at the Reina Sofía Museum, a man approaches her. His name is Dante and he is an Argentine historian researching labor struggles in his country and the career of Juan Bialet Massé.

results.title: Masks
results.overview: When the first snow falls, the fifth season begins in the village surrounded by mountains. Once a year, the ‘untamed and wild’ is allowed to burst out of the men under the protection of the masks. Somewhere between fairy tale and reality, this documentary paints a picture of a controversial tradition.

results.title: Noche de entierro
results.overview: Overwhelmed by her mother and tired of her grandmother's wake, Noelia escapes to a party with her best friend in search of a break. But leaving the wake proves much harder than she imagined.

results.title: Sempre, sempre
results.overview: Years after separating, Martina and Gerard meet again by chance in Montjuic. The words they say and don’t say open a crack, and memories erupt: a morning at a garden center, a persistent phone call, a chance to escape the consequences of their decisions.

results.title: Henry David Thoreau
results.overview: Henry David Thoreau helped define modern environmentalism and nonviolent resistance, yet his life has been obscured by myth. The author of Walden and Civil Disobedience, he was brilliant but flawed, idealistic but opinionated. A writer, scientist and activist, his words resonate urgently with today’s challenges as humanity looks for ways to live in harmony with nature—and each other.

results.title: Slumber
results.overview: The story is about Mojtaba, an archive employee who is stuck in the boring routine of life. He suffers from sleep disorders and in his dreams meets a woman who changes his life.

results.title: Die Prinzessin aus Glas
results.overview: Hans is the son of a glassmaker – and deaf. Where his daredevil brother failed, he sets out to free Princess Anna, whom a powerful duke holds captive in a glass cage.
